summary: Completed testing of 5 new features for Purnabramha franchise management system. All backend API tests passed (14/14). Frontend UI tests verified all new features are working correctly.

expense_date_range_filter.details: Single/Range toggle buttons working. Range mode shows two date pickers (from/to). Single mode shows one date picker. Expense list updates based on selected date range.

expense_category_in_list.details: Category column visible in expense list table. Expense type field available in Add New Expense form.

franchise_staff_travel_field.details: Staff Traveling Expense field visible in Franchise Management form under Setup Costs section. Shows helper text 'Used for MG (Minimum Guarantee) calculation'.

franchise_gst_toggle.details: GST Applicable on Revenue Share toggle visible for India locations. Shows description '18% GST (9% CGST + 9% SGST) will be applied to the revenue share payable'.

center_accounts_mg_payout_tab.details: MG & Payout tab visible in Center Accounts page. Shows Minimum Guarantee vs Revenue Share comparison. Displays 'Amount Payable This Month' with explanation of which is higher.

center_accounts_api_mg_calculation.details: API returns mg_calculation and payout fields in summary response. MG calculation includes total_investment, deductions, net_investment, monthly_mg, interest_rate, tenure_years.

seed_data_creation: Test franchises created and deleted during backend tests (TEST-STAFF-*, TEST-GST-ON-*, TEST-GST-OFF-*)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 new features are working correctly. The MG calculation shows Rs. 0.00 when no franchise is linked to a center. To test MG calculation with actual values, need to create a franchise with setup costs and link it to a center. WhatsApp integration for Booking Intelligence module is MOCKED.
